title: DNA Extraction for Illumina 16S rRNA
author: Vincent Young
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7kxhkxn

steps.title: Prepare PowerMag Glass Bead Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the PowerMag Glass Bead plate for sample collection, ensuring proper labeling and control allocation.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the PowerMag Glass Bead plate to collect beads at the bottom of the well.
In a clean hood, add a maximum of 0.25g or 250 uL of sample to the plate.
Seal the plate with a mat.
Reserve at least three wells in the bead plate for controls (maximum of 93 samples per plate).
Clearly label plates with PI, Reference ID, and date.

steps.title: Prepare for Shipping
steps.instruction: Prepare the Bead plates for shipping using the same instructions as PCR plates.

steps.title: Complete Documentation
steps.instruction: Complete the necessary administrative requirements for sample submission.

substeps.instruction: Send the electronic plate map and shipment tracking information to msmblcore@umich.edu.

steps.title: Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Ship the samples on dry ice to the specified address, including the reference ID on package documentation.

substeps.instruction: Address shipment to: Attention: April Cockburn, Mouse Metabolic Phenotyping Centers, University of Michigan Medical School, Internal Medicine/Infectious Diseases, 1500 MSRB1, 1150 W. Medical Center Drive, Ann Arbor, MI 48109-5666.
